title: Logical nonlinear experts from a shared KAN edge-function basis
hypothesis: A shared KAN parent basis with small expert Views provides multiple useful nonlinear experts at lower complete bytes and comparable active edge compute than dense MoE experts and beats native GS-KAN transforms.

world.teacher: each expert is a distinct combination of shared analytic edge parents
world.router: fixed balanced expert assignment for measurement

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed on exact native GS-KAN transform alias or byte/quality gate failure.

controls: native GS-KAN shared parent with expert affine transforms
Mirror expert codes on shared edge basis
metrics: serialized inference bytes incl router and IDs
success_gate: heldout nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer bytes than dense MoE and strict quality/runtime gain over native GS-KAN at equal physical basis.
failure_gate: FAIL if GS-KAN exactly matches expert Views or quality/storage/compute frontier fails.

compute.router: fixed balanced IDs are still paid metadata

boundaries: Synthetic analytic nonlinear experts only; no trained KAN/MoE model claim.
Balanced expert IDs are supplied and stored; routing learning is not evaluated.
No fresh data after native alias or gate failure.
